# Monthly Active Users (MAU) Analysis

This report analyzes the Monthly Active Users (MAU) over time and includes a trend line.

```{r}
# Load the data
MAU <- read.csv("MAU.csv")

# Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# Convert month to Date format
MAU$month <- as.Date(paste0(MAU$month, "-01"))

# Basic line plot with trend line
ggplot(MAU, aes(x = month, y = MAU)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Active Users (MAU) Over Time",
       x = "Month", y = "Monthly Active Users") +
  theme_minimal()
```
